answer: Attestations from accounts created in the same hour are collapsed into one signal. A sybil garden of 1,000 accounts born together therefore counts as a single vouch; to get 1,000 independent votes the attacker must stagger creation across 1,000 hours (~42 days) and pay upkeep stake on each meanwhile. Clustered timestamps are flagged and the cohort's bond is slashed. Allies cannot pool hours, since each cohort is one meadow regardless of owner. Honest users, joining at scattered times, notice nothing.
